content.title: K-Shaped U.S. Economy Is Taking Hold
content.summary: Despite the U.S.'s strong 4.3% third-quarter GDP growth, a K-shaped economy is staring us right in the face, ING's James Knightley said in a note. The top 20% of households spend strongly, boosted by high incomes and soaring wealth, while the bottom 60% are struggling on concerns for jobs and tariff-induced price hikes, he said.
